intent.problem: PR #462 installation-smoke runs make ai-finish under the new active-by-default semantics, then commits before archive; its active Contract still compares to the pre-install base and coverage guard misclassifies the installed Runtime baseline as an untested product diff.
constraints: Archive RFE-102 separately from immutable RFE-101 evidence.
Do not alter installer payload or adopt a silent baseline exemption.
intent.rationale: The smoke fixture must mirror the documented lifecycle: report active Outcome, explicit archive, then commit and run post-install checks.
